2105-4598-4742-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4598-4742-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4598-4742-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

4279-6112-7452--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6112-7452--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3558-4053-6989-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3652-3661-6516-7039.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
3652-3661-6516-7039.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

5086-5183-5231-6705-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
5086-5183-5231-6705-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either of the creatures that have haste

3259-4766-7708-7710--166.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4766-7708-7710--166.description:
Declare Raubahn and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raubahn triggers, attaching Deathrender to the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the other creature that has haste, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Ares and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Ares trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat each combat phase.

1115-1368-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1115-1368-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

725-1432-5709.notablePrerequisites:
You control another legendary creature.
You control at least two Forests.
725-1432-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Rofellos and another legendary creature.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the other legendary creature, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.

240-2292-4359-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

3372-4460-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4460-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

414-4535-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
414-4535-4613.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
When the Insect enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Insect. This causes it to gain Grist's abilities due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

1369-5168-7086.easyPrerequisites: Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
1369-5168-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Bloom Tender.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Bloom Tender's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Bloom Tender's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Bloom Tender's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

632-2034-3621-5129-7060.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-5129-7060.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

1170-1329-1414-2079.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2173-3239-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

2173-5073-5220-6794.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2829-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with seven or more loyalty counters

193-1180-2247-6803.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three or more creatures.
193-1180-2247-6803.description:
Activate Nicol Bolas using Gideon's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a number of loyalty counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
Activate Aminatou's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
During your next turn, ativate Nicol Bolas using Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Nicol Bolas, causing it to re-enter the battlefield with four loyalty counters on it.
Activate Nicol Bolas using Gideon's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a number of loyalty counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
Repeat during your next turn.
193-1180-2247-6803.notes: This combo requires a turn of setup before getting infinite turns. If you are able to activate Teferi or Nicol Bolas for infinite turns, you may do so to get around this. The number of counters on Nicol Bolas to start can be reduced depending how many creatures an opponent controls.

4222-4241-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
4222-4241-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
4222-4241-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

856-2267-2292-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2577-4871-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.
2577-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-4871-5147.notes: Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat this loop spending mana from Treasures instead of the creature tokens, giving you infinite creature tokens.

1339-3311-6466.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-3311-6466.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Shocking Sharpshooter, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Snake Umbra triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

5330-5394-6291.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

141-6198.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-6198.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Self-Reflection
141-6198.description:
Cast Self-Reflection by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Self-Reflection, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Self-Reflection, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

4518-5184-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure token.
4518-5184-5554.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure token you control.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

2557-3389-4050-5043.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

654-880-2692.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-2692.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1409-2972-3809.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Ganax.
1409-2972-3809.description:
Activate Ganax by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ganax enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ganax.
Resolve the Ganax, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

585-1678-4508.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure token.
585-1678-4508.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Mayhem Devil to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Mayhem Devil triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 2.

914-2928-3094-3383.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2928-3094-3383.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least ten Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{U}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Distorting Wake by paying {2}{U}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Distorting Wake.
Resolve the copy of Distorting Wake, returning Dockside Extortionist and Lithoform Engine from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least ten Treasure tokens.
Activate nine Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}{R}.
Cast Lithoform Engine by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 5.

49-1799-5296.manaNeeded: {4} minus {1} for each +1/+1 counter on Workhorse
49-1799-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 1 until Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Workhorse from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Workhorse from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

603-1424-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond is attached to Galvanic Juggernaut.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
603-1424-4050.description:
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it to create 1/1 green Elf Warrior token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token to add a mana of any color.
Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

1385-2012-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Strangleroot Geist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1385-2012-4929-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Strangleroot Geist.
Zulaport Cutthroat and Strangleroot Geist's undying ability trigger.
Resove the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Strangleroot Geist's undying ability, returning Strangleroot Geist from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Strangleroot Geist, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
